events.title: Infinity Bounce x Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hi everyone! To celebrate Steam Next Fest, we've just released the biggest demo update so far. Thanks a bunch to everyone who played and sent us feedback over the last weeks! MAXTUPLE ZOOMIESFormerly known as "Frenzy", the Space Cat's Zoomies got a lot of love. You can now level up the cat while it's still having the zoomies, creating a chain with effects that just keep on getting crazier. This will later also tie into some challenges/milestones! events.title: Infinity Bounce Dev-Blog #1
events.summary: Welcome to Infinity Bounce's official first development blog post!Many of you have been asking for a way to see which path shooting stars are taking. We've also heard a lot of requests for the ability to single out a shooting star easily.After some tinkering, we've come up with a solution that should cover both of these pain points. events.title: Infinity Bounce Demo v0.6.2
events.summary: Hi everyone!Thanks a lot for all the great feedback so far! Our team has been busy at work - we fixed a couple of issues and added many quality-of-life improvements.We also decided to add a completely new toy to the demo: The Particle Accelerator! It works like a planet, but also fires a beam when hit. The beam will trigger other Planets (and other Particle Accelerators), creating an opportunity to earn tons of points.We're looking forward to see what contraptions you'll create with this new toy
